title: Orchestrator shutdown waits for training work off the event loop, bounded
statement: Orchestrator.shutdown() cancels queued training futures, waits for the in-flight job in a helper thread so the event loop keeps serving /livez and /readyz, and gives up after EXECUTOR_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_S with a warning instead of hanging.
failure_mode: A blocking ThreadPoolExecutor.shutdown(wait=True) froze the event loop for the length of a model fit, stalling health probes and every remaining cleanup step.
